about.title: About Nova Link China
about.subtitle: Your bridge to quality Chinese manufacturing
about.intro: Nova Link China is a Zhengzhou-based trading company dedicated to connecting global buyers with China's finest manufacturers. We specialize in medical devices — leveraging deep relationships with factories in Henan province and beyond.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To simplify global sourcing from China by providing transparent pricing, uncompromised quality, and seamless communication across languages and cultures.

advantage.title: Our Advantage
advantage.text: Rooted in Zhengzhou, at the heart of China's manufacturing hub, we have direct, long-term partnerships with certified factories. Every product is verified for quality and compliance before shipment.
